title: HISTORY FORM 1
text:
HISTORY FORM ONE MARKING SCHEME
 1. Define the following terms
 a) History (1mk)
 Is the study of mans past chronological account and record of events in reaction to the
 environment
 b) Government (1mk)
 It is the practice of ruling or exercising continuous authority over ones subjects
 c) Pre- history(1mk)
 Are the activities in which human beings engaged before the invention of writing and
 drawing for storing information.
 2. Name the two types of monarchy (2mks)
 a. Absolute monarchy
 b. Constitutional monarchy
 3. Name the three characteristics of the government (2mks)
 i. Rules
 ii. Sovererignity
 iii. Jurisdiction
 iv. Legitimacy
 v. Law enforcement
 4. Give two types of electronic sources of information on history and government (2mks)
 i. Microfilms
 ii. Films
 iii. Videos
 iv. Radio
 v. Television
 vi. Computer databases
 5. What is oral tradition as a source of history(1mk)
 Refers to the practice of handling downhistorical information by the word of mouth from
 one generation to the next.
 6. State the three branches of studying history (3mks)
 i. Political history
 ii. Social history
 iii. Economic history
 7. Give one disadvantage of anthropology as a source of history (1mk)
 i. It is an expensive method as it involves living among the people.
 ii. It is time consuming method of acquiring information.
 iii. People under study may try to behave differently when a researcher is around. A
 researcher may therefore miss important details.
 iv. It is difficult for a researcher to adapt to the environment since the people they are
 studying may be of a totally different culture.
 8.Define the term “evolution “ (1mk)
 It is the process of slow or gradual change from a simple to a better adapted and superior
 form(complex form)
 9. Give two reasons why east Africa is referred to as cradle of mankind(2mks)
 i. Many remains of early man have found in Africa specifically in east Africa.
 ii. The environment in east Africa was also conducive for early man.
 iii. Many artifacts (remains of tools and weapons used by early man)have also been
 found in Africa around lake victoria and in the rift valley.
 iv. The earliest apes and various animals may have first lived around what is now lake
 victoria and the rift valley.
 10. Identify any two archaeological sites in Uganda (2mks)
 i. Nsongezi
 ii. Magosi
 iii. Ishanga
 iv. Nyabusora
 v. Nyero
 vi. Paraa
 vii. Mweya
 11. Which stage of evolution is associated with acheulian tools (1mk)
 Homo eructus
 12. State an any two differences between man and ape (2mks)
 i. Compared to apes man has larger brain capacity
 ii. Man walked in an upright posture unlike apes
 iii. Man has a straight forehead while apes had a sloping forehead
 iv. Man developed speech and could invent things unlike apes
 v. Man has a small jaw and canines while apes have powerful jaws and long canines
 13.Give any two scientific sources of history in Kenya communities during the pre-colonial
 period (2mks)
 i. Genetics
 ii. Linguistic
 14. Give one economic reason for studying history and government (1mk)
 It helps us to develop a career choice
 15. Define the term stone age(1mk)
 Refers to aperiod in history when man widely used stone as a raw material to make tools
 and weapons.
 16. Name three uses of fire by the early man (3mks)fire provided warmth in the night
 i. It provided light in the night
 ii. Man used fire to cook and soften his food
 iii. It was used for hardening the tips of tools
 iv. Fire was used for frightening away animals
 v. It was used for food preservation
 vi. Fire was used as a means of communication this was through smoke and fire signals.
